summary: v9 — INVENTMENT Free/PRO tier + Stripe checkout + measure column. Created /app/backend/tests/test_v9_billing.py with 11 NEW pytest cases — ALL 11 PASS in 10s. Verified: (1) New user registers with plan=free (auth/me includes plan). (2) GET /api/billing/plan returns {plan:'free', limits:{products:9,categories:9,warehouses:2,suppliers:9}, usage:{...}, price:{amount:6.99, currency:'EUR', interval:'month'}}. (3) POST /api/billing/checkout returns a REAL Stripe Checkout URL starting with 'https://checkout.stripe.com/' and session_id starting with 'cs_' (cs_test_…) and creates a payment_transactions record. (4) GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} returns payment_status!=paid (unpaid) immediately after checkout and does NOT upgrade the user (plan stays 'free' in both billing/status and /auth/me). (5) Idempotent: double-polling status keeps plan=free, no accidental upgrade. (6) FREE-tier limits enforced correctly with HTTP 403 + detail 'limit_reached:<kind>:<cap>:free' — verified end-to-end on isolated TEST_v9_ users: 3rd warehouse → 403 limit_reached:warehouses:2:free; 10th category → 403 limit_reached:categories:9:free; 10th supplier → 403 limit_reached:suppliers:9:free; 10th product → 403 limit_reached:products:9:free. (7) Product measure_value/measure_unit persisted and returned on GET /products/{id}. Frontend Playwright (390x844 mobile viewport, public preview URL, logged-in as warehouse@test.com/test123): Settings tab Plan card renders exactly per spec — 'Free Plan' title, 'FREE' badge, usage line 'Products: 1/9 · Warehouse: 2/2 · Categories: 0/9 · Suppliers: 0/9', pitch 'Unlock up to 9999 products, 19 warehouses, 99 categories and 9999 suppliers.', and primary CTA testID='upgrade-btn' with exact label 'Upgrade to PRO · 6.99 EUR/month'. Tapping upgrade-btn fires POST /api/billing/checkout (response 200) and then window.location.href navigates the browser to the real Stripe Checkout page (https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_…) showing 'Payment €6.99 Sandbox' with the Stripe card form — confirming the full FE→BE→Stripe handshake. Per main agent's instruction we did NOT complete a real card payment. Catalog/PDF/CSV measure column wiring verified at source level: catalog.tsx:167 renders `${item.measure_value} ${item.measure_unit}` on each row; orders.tsx buildRows() at :85 maps p.measure_value/unit into r.measure; PDF table at :131 includes <th>{t('measure')}</th>; CSV headers at :142 include t('measure') and rows include r.measure at the matching index. Limit-prompt UX: settings.tsx save() catches 'limit_reached' and shows Alert.alert(proRequired, limitFreeHint, [cancel, upgradeToPro->upgrade()]) — on web preview RN Alert.alert is a no-op so the prompt isn't visible there (same class of limitation as v7 mailto: and v8 delete-confirm). Works on native iOS/Android builds. Backend lifecycle is clean: no 500s observed; bcrypt benign warning carryover only.

minor.issue: Carryover benign warning 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' at startup. Cosmetic.

integration_issues.flow: Free-user hits limit (e.g. add 3rd warehouse) → expects Upgrade prompt
integration_issues.issue: react-native Alert.alert is a no-op on react-native-web. The save() catch in settings.tsx fires Alert.alert(proRequired, limitFreeHint, [...{onPress: upgrade}]) but nothing renders in the web preview. Functional on native builds. Recommend a Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm + auto-call upgrade() so the prompt is also exercisable from the web preview (and useful for web publish).

react_native_issues.issue: Same carryover web limitation as v7/v8 — Alert.alert(...) renders nothing on RN-Web, so the proRequired limit-reached upgrade prompt and the upgrade-failed alert never surface in the web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:78-84 (limit prompt) and :52 (upgrade-failed alert).
Carryover deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:265-266 — PRO_LIMITS and FREE_LIMITS dicts. FREE = {products:9, categories:9, warehouses:2, suppliers:9}; PRO = {products:9999, categories:99, warehouses:19, suppliers:9999}. Matches PRD exactly.

server.py:273-278 — enforce_limit raises HTTPException(403, detail=f'limit_reached:{kind}:{cap}:{plan}'). Detail format matches spec ('limit_reached:<kind>:<cap>:<plan>'). Wired into POST /warehouses, /categories, /suppliers, /products.

server.py:903-985 — Billing endpoints. GET /billing/plan returns {plan, limits, usage, plan_expires_at, price:{amount:6.99, currency:'EUR', interval:'month'}}. POST /billing/checkout uses StripeCheckout(api_key=STRIPE_API_KEY) with origin-based success/cancel URLs and metadata{user_id, plan:'pro', type:'pro_monthly'}; persists payment_transactions row with payment_status='initiated'. GET /billing/status/{session_id} polls Stripe; ONLY when st.payment_status=='paid' AND (tx missing OR tx.payment_status!='paid') does it upgrade — idempotency guard prevents double-upgrade. Sets plan_expires_at = now+30 days.
server.py:31-33 — PRO_PRICE_AMOUNT=6.99, PRO_PRICE_CURRENCY='eur', PRO_PERIOD_DAYS=30. Matches PRD.
server.py:209,229 — registration sets plan='free' default; /auth/me echoes plan in _public_user response.

settings.tsx:141-164 — Plan card uses billing.usage/limits live; testID='upgrade-btn' label exactly `${t('upgradeToPro')} · ${billing.price.amount} ${billing.price.currency}/${t('month')}`. Verified live as 'Upgrade to PRO · 6.99 EUR/month'.

settings.tsx:40-54 upgrade() — origin = window.location.origin (web) or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (native); POST /billing/checkout with origin_url; on success window.location.href = url (web) or Linking.openURL (native). Verified live: real Stripe Checkout page opens with €6.99 Sandbox.

settings.tsx:62-86 save() — catches err.message includes 'limit_reached' and triggers Alert.alert(proRequired, limitFreeHint, [cancel, upgradeToPro:upgrade]). Correct shape; web-only limitation: Alert.alert no-op on RN-Web.

billing-return.tsx — polls /billing/status/{session_id} every 2s up to 8 times; on payment_status=='paid' OR plan=='pro' refreshes user and shows success; on cancel shows canceled; otherwise pending. testID='billing-done' present. Correct UX.
auth.tsx:4,82 — User type includes plan; default plan exposed as 'free' when user null. refreshUser() and plan field flow correctly to settings card.
orders.tsx:85,106,131,142,145 — measure column wired in buildRows (`${measure_value} ${measure_unit}`), PDF table header+row, CSV header+row. Spec satisfied.

rca_of_issue: No bugs found — all features in the request work end-to-end. The one carryover web-only limitation (RN Alert.alert no-op) is the same platform constraint already documented in iterations 7 and 8; it is a react-native-web limitation, not an INVENTMENT bug. Mitigation if main agent wants browser-preview parity: branch on Platform.OS==='web' to use window.confirm/alert (a ~10-line change in settings.tsx save() and upgrade()).
